What Is New?
ORA Improvements to Internal Monitoring Documentation
Improved Documentation ORA Performance Confirmation
More Complete Risk Assessments Invoicing Confirmation
Comprehensive evaluation of subrecipient risk prior to award execution. ORA will verify subrecipient invoicing with the Morgan PI to ensure accuracy and
timeliness.
Award-Specific Commitment Forms Technical Report Confirmation
Tailored subrecipient commitment forms linked to each specific award. ORA will confirm receipt and review of technical/progress reports with the Morgan PI.
Annual Certifications
Annual certification requirements for all collaborating institutions.
NOTE: We are working through our first cycle of updated documentation. Some procedures may evolve as we develop a sustainable model.

What Are We Asking of You?
Responsibilities of Morgan PI / Support Staff
Invoice Review & Management Project Deliverables Management
1 Verify Invoice Accuracy 1 Review Technical Progress
Ensure all subrecipient invoices reflect allowable costs and are mathematically Continuously review subrecipient technical reports and progress against the
correct. approved scope of work.
2 Obtain Proper Signatures 2 Monitor Deliverable Timelines
Invoices must be properly signed and approved before submitting to Track deliverable due dates and ensure subrecipients are on schedule with project
MSUAP@morgan.edu. milestones.
3 Report Delinquent Invoicing 3 Alert ORA of Performance Issues
Promptly alert ORA if subrecipient invoicing is overdue or missing. Immediately notify ORA if a subrecipient fails to meet technical deliverables or
scope requirements.
Morgan State University | Office of Research Administration SUBRECIPIENT MONITORING

Please Consider
Morgan Is Being Monitored — Compliance Reminders for All PIs
Timely & Accurate Banner Entry
1 Ensure all project expenses are entered into Banner in a timely and accurate manner. Late or incorrect entries can trigger compliance flags during sponsor monitoring visits.
Budget Changes Require Pre-Approval
2 Some budget modifications require prior sponsor approval before costs can be incurred. Consult ORA before reallocating funds across budget categories or making significant
changes.
Assist With Closeout
3 Timely completion of close-out documentation and certifications is critical. Please assist ORA in completing all required reports, financial reconciliations, and certifications by
the project end date.
